NKJV.1: It came to pass on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
NKJV.2: And he said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a young bull as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
NKJV.3: And to the children of Israel you shall speak, saying, ‘Take a kid of the goats as a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, as a burnt offering,
NKJV.4: also a bull and a ram as peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today the LORD will appear to you.’ ”
NKJV.5: So they brought what Moses commanded before the tabernacle of meeting. And all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
NKJV.6: Then Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded you to do, and the glory of the LORD will appear to you.”
NKJV.7: And Moses said to Aaron, “Go to the altar, offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for the people. Offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”
NKJV.8: Aaron therefore went to the altar and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
NKJV.9: Then the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him. And he dipped his finger in the blood, put it on the horns of the altar, and poured the blood at the base of the altar.
NKJV.10: But the fat, the kidneys, and the fatty lobe from the liver of the sin offering he burned on the altar, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.11: The flesh and the hide he burned with fire outside the camp.
NKJV.12: And he killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled all around on the altar.
NKJV.13: Then they presented the burnt offering to him, with its pieces and head, and he burned them on the altar.
NKJV.14: And he washed the entrails and the legs, and burned them with the burnt offering on the altar.
NKJV.15: Then he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and killed it and offered it for sin, like the first one.
NKJV.16: And he brought the burnt offering and offered it according to the prescribed manner.
NKJV.17: Then he brought the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, besides the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
NKJV.18: He also killed the bull and the ram as sacrifices of peace offerings, which were for the people. And Aaron’s sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled all around on the altar,
NKJV.19: and the fat from the bull and the ram—the fatty tail, what covers the entrails and the kidneys, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver;
NKJV.20: and they put the fat on the breasts. Then he burned the fat on the altar;
NKJV.21: but the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved as a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses had commanded.
NKJV.22: Then Aaron lifted his hand toward the people, blessed them, and came down from offering the sin offering, the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
NKJV.23: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of meeting, and came out and blessed the people. Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people,
NKJV.24: and fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.

ESV.1: On the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel,
ESV.2: and he said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
ESV.3: And say to the people of Israel, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both a year old without blemish, for a burnt offering,
ESV.4: and an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil, for today the LORD will appear to you.’”
ESV.5: And they brought what Moses commanded in front of the tent of meeting, and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
ESV.6: And Moses said, “This is the thing that the LORD commanded you to do, that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”
ESV.7: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and for the people, and bring the offering of the people and make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded.”
ESV.8: So Aaron drew near to the altar and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
ESV.9: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar and poured out the blood at the base of the altar.
ESV.10: But the fat and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering he burned on the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.
ESV.11: The flesh and the skin he burned up with fire outside the camp.
ESV.12: Then he killed the burnt offering, and Aaron's sons handed him the blood, and he threw it against the sides of the altar.
ESV.13: And they handed the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head, and he burned them on the altar.
ESV.14: And he washed the entrails and the legs and burned them with the burnt offering on the altar.
ESV.15: Then he presented the people's offering and took the goat of the sin offering that was for the people and killed it and offered it as a sin offering, like the first one.
ESV.16: And he presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the rule.
ESV.17: And he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
ESV.18: Then he killed the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings for the people. And Aaron's sons handed him the blood, and he threw it against the sides of the altar.
ESV.19: But the fat pieces of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail and that which covers the entrails and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver —
ESV.20: they put the fat pieces on the breasts, and he burned the fat pieces on the altar,
ESV.21: but the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.
ESV.22: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he came down from offering the sin offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings.
ESV.23: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and when they came out they blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
ESV.24: And fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the pieces of fat on the altar, and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.

NASB.1: Now it came about on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel;
NASB.2: and he said to Aaron, 'Take for yourself a calf, a bull, for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, [both] without defect, and offer [them] before the LORD.
NASB.3: 'Then to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying, 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both one year old, without defect, for a burnt offering,
NASB.4: and an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today the LORD will appear to you.''
NASB.5: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the whole congregation came near and stood before the LORD.
NASB.6: Moses said, 'This is the thing which the LORD has commanded you to do, that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.'
NASB.7: Moses then said to Aaron, 'Come near to the altar and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, that you may make atonement for yourself and for the people; then make the offering for the people, that you may make atonement for them, just as the LORD has commanded.'
NASB.8: So Aaron came near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering which was for himself.
NASB.9: Aaron's sons presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood and put [some] on the horns of the altar, and poured out [the rest of] the blood at the base of the altar.
NASB.10: The fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver of the sin offering, he then offered up in smoke on the altar just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.11: The flesh and the skin, however, he burned with fire outside the camp.
NASB.12: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons handed the blood to him and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
NASB.13: They handed the burnt offering to him in pieces, with the head, and he offered [them] up in smoke on the altar.
NASB.14: He also washed the entrails and the legs, and offered [them] up in smoke with the burnt offering on the altar.
NASB.15: Then he presented the people's offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and slaughtered it and offered it for sin, like the first.
NASB.16: He also presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
NASB.17: Next he presented the grain offering, and filled his hand with some of it and offered [it] up in smoke on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
NASB.18: Then he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings which was for the people; and Aaron's sons handed the blood to him and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
NASB.19: As for the portions of fat from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail, and the [fat] covering, and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver,
NASB.20: they now placed the portions of fat on the breasts; and he offered them up in smoke on the altar.
NASB.21: But the breasts and the right thigh Aaron presented as a wave offering before the LORD, just as Moses had commanded.
NASB.22: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he stepped down after making the sin offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings.
NASB.23: Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting. When they came out and blessed the people, the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
NASB.24: Then fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the portions of fat on the altar; and when all the people saw [it], they shouted and fell on their faces.

CSB17.1: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron, his sons, and the elders of Israel. <sup>ⓘ</sup>
CSB17.2: He said to Aaron, “Take a young bull for a sin <sup>[1]</sup> offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, <sup>ⓙ</sup> and present them before the LORD.
CSB17.3: And tell the Israelites: <sup>[2]</sup> Take a male goat for a sin offering; a calf and a lamb, male yearlings without blemish, for a burnt offering;
CSB17.4: an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the LORD; and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD is going to appear <sup>ⓚ</sup> to you.”
CSB17.5: They brought what Moses had commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the whole community came forward and stood before the LORD.
CSB17.6: Moses said, “This is what the LORD commanded you to do, that the glory of the LORD <sup>ⓛ</sup> may appear to you.”
CSB17.7: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Approach the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering; make atonement for yourself and the people. <sup>[3]</sup> <sup>ⓜ</sup> Sacrifice the people’s offering and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”
CSB17.8: So Aaron approached the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
CSB17.9: Aaron’s sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and applied it to the horns of the altar. He poured out the blood at the base of the altar.
CSB17.10: He burned the fat, the kidneys, and the fatty lobe of the liver from the sin offering on the altar, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
CSB17.11: He burned the flesh and the hide <sup>ⓝ</sup> outside the camp. <sup>ⓐ</sup>
CSB17.12: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. Aaron’s sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it on all sides of the altar.
CSB17.13: They brought him the burnt offering piece by piece, along with the head, and he burned them on the altar.
CSB17.14: He washed the entrails and the legs and burned them with the burnt offering on the altar.
CSB17.15: Aaron presented the people’s offering. He took the male goat for the people’s sin offering, slaughtered it, and made a sin offering with it as he did before.
CSB17.16: He presented the burnt offering and sacrificed it according to the regulation. <sup>ⓑ</sup>
CSB17.17: Next he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning burnt offering. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.18: Finally, he slaughtered the ox and the ram as the people’s fellowship sacrifice. Aaron’s sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it on all sides of the altar.
CSB17.19: They also brought the fat portions from the ox and the ram — the fat tail, the fat surrounding the entrails, the kidneys, and the fatty lobe of the liver —
CSB17.20: and placed these on the breasts. Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar,
CSB17.21: but he presented the breasts <sup>ⓓ</sup> and the right thigh as a presentation offering <sup>ⓔ</sup> before the LORD, as Moses had commanded. <sup>[4]</sup>
CSB17.22: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed <sup>ⓕ</sup> them. He came down after sacrificing the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the fellowship offering.
CSB17.23: Moses and Aaron then entered the tent of meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
CSB17.24: Fire came from the LORD and consumed <sup>ⓖ</sup> the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted <sup>ⓗ</sup> and fell facedown. <sup>ⓘ</sup>

NLT.1: After the ordination ceremony, on the eighth day, Moses called together Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
NLT.2: He said to Aaron, “Take a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without defects, and present them to the LORD.
NLT.3: Then tell the Israelites, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, and take a calf and a lamb, both a year old and without defects, for a burnt offering.
NLT.4: Also take a bull and a ram for a peace offering and flour moistened with olive oil for a grain offering. Present all these offerings to the LORD because the LORD will appear to you today.’”
NLT.5: So the people presented all these things at the entrance of the Tabernacle, just as Moses had commanded. Then the whole community came forward and stood before the LORD.
NLT.6: And Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded you to do so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”
NLT.7: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering to purify yourself and the people. Then present the offerings of the people to purify them, making them right with the LORD, just as he has commanded.”
NLT.8: So Aaron went to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
NLT.9: His sons brought him the blood, and he dipped his finger in it and put it on the horns of the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
NLT.10: Then he burned on the altar the fat, the kidneys, and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NLT.11: The meat and the hide, however, he burned outside the camp.
NLT.12: Next Aaron slaughtered the animal for the burnt offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all sides of the altar.
NLT.13: Then they handed him each piece of the burnt offering, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
NLT.14: Then he washed the internal organs and the legs and burned them on the altar along with the rest of the burnt offering.
NLT.15: Next Aaron presented the offerings of the people. He slaughtered the people’s goat and presented it as an offering for their sin, just as he had first done with the offering for his own sin.
NLT.16: Then he presented the burnt offering and sacrificed it in the prescribed way.
NLT.17: He also presented the grain offering, burning a handful of the flour mixture on the altar, in addition to the regular burnt offering for the morning.
NLT.18: Then Aaron slaughtered the bull and the ram for the people’s peace offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all sides of the altar.
NLT.19: Then he took the fat of the bull and the ram — the fat of the broad tail and from around the internal organs — along with the kidneys and the long lobes of the livers.
NLT.20: He placed these fat portions on top of the breasts of these animals and burned them on the altar.
NLT.21: Aaron then lifted up the breasts and right thighs as a special offering to the LORD, just as Moses had commanded.
NLT.22: After that, Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them. Then, after presenting the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offering, he stepped down from the altar.
NLT.23: Then Moses and Aaron went into the Tabernacle, and when they came back out, they blessed the people again, and the glory of the LORD appeared to the whole community.
NLT.24: Fire blazed forth from the LORD’s presence and consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. When the people saw this, they shouted with joy and fell face down on the ground.

WEB.1: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
WEB.2: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before Yahweh.
WEB.3: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
WEB.4: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”
WEB.5: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting: and all the congregation came near and stood before Yahweh.
WEB.6: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do: and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
WEB.7: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as Yahweh commanded.”
WEB.8: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
WEB.9: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:
WEB.10: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
WEB.11: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
WEB.12: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
WEB.13: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burned them upon the altar.
WEB.14: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
WEB.15: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
WEB.16: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
WEB.17: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
WEB.18: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar,
WEB.19: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver:
WEB.20: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar:
WEB.21: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.

AMP.1: And it happened on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel;
AMP.2: and he said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering, [each] without blemish, and offer both before the LORD.
AMP.3: Then say to the Israelites, 'Take a male goat as a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both one year old, without blemish, as a burnt offering,
AMP.4: and a bull and a ram as peace offerings to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with [olive] oil, for today the LORD will appear to you.'"
AMP.5: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and all the congregation approached and stood before the LORD.
AMP.6: Moses said, "This is the thing which the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you."
AMP.7: Moses said to Aaron, "Approach the altar and present your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and for the people; and present the offering of the people and make atonement for them, just as the LORD has commanded."
AMP.8: So Aaron approached the altar and killed the calf as the sin offering, which was designated for himself.
AMP.9: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; he dipped his finger in the blood and put some of it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the rest of the blood at the altar's base;
AMP.10: but the fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering he offered up in smoke on the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
AMP.11: And Aaron burned the meat and the hide in the fire outside the camp.
AMP.12: Then he killed the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons handed the blood to him and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
AMP.13: They brought the burnt offering to him piece by piece, with the head, and Aaron offered them up in smoke on the altar.
AMP.14: He also washed the entrails and the legs, and offered them up in smoke with the burnt offering on the altar.
AMP.15: Then Aaron presented the people's offering. He took the goat for the sin offering of the people, and killed it and offered it for sin, as he did the first.
AMP.16: He also presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance.
AMP.17: Next Aaron presented the grain offering and took a handful of it and offered it up in smoke on the altar in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
AMP.18: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings which was for the people; and Aaron's sons handed the blood to him and he sprinkled it around on the altar,
AMP.19: As for the portions of fat from the bull and from the ram—the fat tail, and the fat covering the internal organs, and the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver—
AMP.20: they now put the portions of fat on the breasts; and Aaron offered the fat up in smoke on the altar.
AMP.21: But the breasts and the right thigh Aaron presented as a wave offering before the LORD, just as Moses had commanded.
AMP.22: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them, and came down [from the altar of burnt offering] after presenting the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
AMP.23: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came out they blessed the people, and the glory and brilliance of the LORD [the Shekinah cloud] appeared to all the people [as promised].
AMP.24: Then fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the portions of fat on the altar; and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell face downward [in awe and worship].
